venezuela.note: M7.2 + M7.5 earthquakes (~35 x 33 km around the epicentre). Public data only from ~17 Jun, so the 'before' side is short. Backscatter barely changes; use GUNW for displacement.

nepal.note: Langtang valley + Timure (~29 x 17 km). Data gap 27 Jul - 10 Aug 2026. Try --pol HHHH and --diff.

spain_fire.note: Avila wildfire near Burgohondo (~46 x 33 km, approximate). HV shows burn best. after_from skips the early 26 Jul scene (fire still growing) and uses a post-gap scene.
